title: Where the pain points cluster on the journey
subtitle: The 65 records typed as a pain point, counted by the substage of the incident journey they sit on.
note: The heaviest substage is the one the reporter cannot get right: completing the form. The second is deciding whether a thing is worth reporting at all. Both are what the redesign changes.
source: Counted from the records typed as pain points in the research tool's database.
